title: Knock down one AprilTag with the ball (VEX AIM, 18 in field)
description: Grab the magnetic sports ball and use it to knock down the standing AprilTag sign, in 60 s. 1 point when the sign falls because the ball hit it; knocking it down with the robot (or by pushing the ball into it while carrying it) does not count and is flagged. Arena: the 18 x 18 in (0.457 m) VEX AIM field, 4 tiles. Layout 'photo' reproduces a team's start photo. MotionBench-defined, not an official VEX game.
